other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Ensembling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same global validation set for early stopping the MLP models and for tuning the final ensemble weights. This makes the MLP's validation predictions overly optimistic, leading to biased ensemble weights and an unreliable final validation score.

summary: The agent demonstrates strong feature engineering and modeling practices, successfully implementing target encoding, deep learning, and gradient boosting. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random train/validation split. Furthermore, the agent introduces validation leakage by early-stopping the MLP on the same holdout set used for optimizing ensemble weights, and it incorrectly implements the LightGBM cross-validation loop by ignoring the validation folds.
